title: CD flow definition
description: Defines how a service is deployed: the environments it targets and the ordered steps that carry out the deploy. A step may stand on its own or be a stage, which groups the steps that deploy to one environment tier. A flow whose steps are all common steps deploys nothing and so targets no environment.

environments.description: The environments this flow deploys to, keyed by environment id. Optional: a flow of only common steps targets no environment, so it may omit this or leave it empty. Every environment a step names must be a key here. The per-service configuration under each environment is defined by the deploy driver's service_environment schema, not here.

steps.description: The top-level ordered sequence for the flow, run in order.

services.description: The services deployed to this environment, keyed by service name. Each value is that service's configuration for this environment, defined by the deploy driver's service_environment schema and opaque to this schema.

topLevelStep.description: A step at the top level of the flow: either a stage, or a common step that stands outside any stage. A deploy driver step cannot appear here, because it targets an environment and so belongs to a stage.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: A stage is a deployment to an environment tier. It is type-tagged like any other step so the engine can dispatch a flat sequence, but it groups steps rather than doing work itself. Stages do not nest: a stage's steps are deploy driver steps or common steps.

name.description: A name for this stage, such as 'staging' or 'production'.

steps.description: The steps for this stage, run in order.

stageStep.description: A step within a stage: either a deploy driver step, which targets an environment and whose shape is defined by the driver rather than here, or a common step, which targets no environment.

driverStep.description: A step handled by the deploy driver bound to its target environment. Fields beyond `type` and `environment` are defined by the driver's steps schema and are not validated here, so additional properties are allowed.

type.description: The driver step type, such as 'com.gitlab.cd.argo.rolling.deploy'.

environment.description: The id of the environment this step targets; must be a key in the top-level `environments` object.

commonStep.description: A driver-agnostic step handled by the orchestration engine. Common steps never target an environment.

waitStep.title: Wait
waitStep.description: Pauses the flow for a fixed duration before the next step runs.

seconds.description: How long to wait, in seconds.
